response.rationale: The sweater is apparel, not final sale, delivered 7 days ago, so the standard window (RET-007) would allow it. However, two higher-priority rules both apply at priority 50: RET-050 (goodwill grant, eligible) and RET-051 (fraud hold, ineligible). When rules of equal priority conflict, the fraud hold controls because returns cannot proceed while an account is under fraud review pending resolution; the goodwill exception cannot be applied over an active fraud hold. Therefore the return is ineligible.
